llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Baidu Netdisk connector helper with user-confirmation guidance for state-changing actions.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tool access is limited to Bash commands matching oo *, which is proportionate for a skill whose runtime path is the oo CLI connector.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It includes first-time setup steps that may install the oo CLI via OOMOL's install script, but instructs agents to use them only after a command fails for the matching setup reason.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger says to use the skill for any Baidu Netdisk request, but it remains scoped to that service and explicitly labels write actions and requires confirmation before changing state.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on an OOMOL-connected account and CLI login state, but says credentials are injected server-side and raw tokens are not handled by the agent.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to operate Baidu Netdisk through the OOMOL oo CLI, and the listed read and write actions match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to manage Baidu Netdisk through OOMOL. Review payloads carefully before approving create, copy, move, rename, or upload actions, since those can change your cloud drive contents.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad Baidu Netdisk trigger is present, but artifact instructions keep the scope within one named service and add confirmation requirements for write or destructive actions, so this does not create a Review-level concern by itself.
